headlines.title: Coffee Market in the US to Cross USD 32 Bn by 2032 Fueled by Rising Demand for Specialty Coffee and Premiumization, Reports Mordor Intelligence
headlines.summary: The US coffee market is projected to grow from USD 24.98 billion in 2026 to USD 32.23 billion by 2032, with a CAGR of 4.32%. Market growth is supported by packaged coffee affordability, specialty adoption, app-based ordering, and premium prepared-coffee occasions.

headlines.title: Lubricants Market in India to Hit 6.9 Bn Liters by 2032 Driven by Vehicle Servicing and Manufacturing Growth, Reports Mordor Intelligence
headlines.summary: India's lubricants market is projected to grow from 5.77 billion liters in 2026 to 6.99 billion liters by 2032, with a CAGR of 3.28% during 2027-2032. Growth is driven by expanding vehicle base, manufacturing activities under Make in India initiative, and shift toward premium synthetic oils due to stricter emission norms. The complaint claims Ardelyx failed to disclose increasing payer-related access barriers, stringent prior authorization requirements, and negative impacts on growth prospects for its drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA during the period from January 13, 2025 to August 6, 2026.

DOCS.title: DOCS DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING LAW FIRM, Encourages Doximity, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – DOCS
DOCS.summary: Rosen Law Firm has issued deadline notices for securities class action lawsuits against Doximity, Inc. and Ardelyx, Inc., with a November 16, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The firm is also announcing a newly filed lawsuit against NVIDIA Corporation. Investors who purchased shares during specified class periods may be eligible for compensation.

DOCS.title: ARDX DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, NATIONALLY REGARDED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Ardelyx, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action - ARDX
DOCS.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Ardelyx, Doximity, and NVIDIA. The primary case detailed involves Ardelyx, where investors who purchased stock between January 13, 2025 and August 6, 2026 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges the company made materially false statements regarding commercial performance and growth prospects for its drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA, while concealing reimbursement barriers and prior authorization issues that hindered patient access. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

DOCS.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
DOCS.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has announced multiple class action lawsuits against O-I Glass, Doximity, and UP Fintech for alleged securities fraud violations. O-I Glass investors claim the company made false statements about its Fit to Win cost-saving program and concealed operational challenges. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from November to December 2026.

DOCS.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Doximity, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
DOCS.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Doximity, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims Doximity made false statements about its Newsfeed's revenue impact, overstated market position, and misrepresented advertising practices. Investors who purchased securities between August 8, 2024 and May 13, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

AKAM.title: Akamai Announces Pricing of Offering of Convertible Senior Notes
AKAM.summary: Akamai Technologies announced a $2.2 billion offering of convertible senior notes ($1.1 billion due 2028 at 1.00% and $1.1 billion due 2031 at 1.00%) priced on November 9, 2026. The company plans to use net proceeds to repay maturing 2027 convertible notes and fund capital expenditures for its Cloud Infrastructure Services business. The 2028 notes have a conversion price of $112.41 per share (40% premium to current price), while 2031 notes have a conversion price of $102.37 per share (27.5% premium).

PSIX.title: Power Solutions International Strengthens Longstanding HD Construction Equipment Partnership with Multi-Year Engine Supply Commitment
PSIX.summary: Power Solutions International (PSIX) announced an amendment to its supply agreement with HD Construction Equipment Co., Ltd., an HD Hyundai affiliate, establishing multi-year engine supply commitments. The agreement provides PSI with price certainty and delivery schedules to support growing demand for natural gas power solutions in data centers and critical infrastructure. The partnership, dating back to 2007, strengthens PSI's supply chain and supports its Power Boost 2030 strategy.

BAC.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation for allegedly failing to disclose systemic weaknesses in its Bank of America, N.A. subsidiary's BSA/AML compliance program, which caused it to improperly monitor trillions in transactions and file inaccurate suspicious activity reports. ETD.title: Ethan Allen Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.20 Per Share
ETD.summary: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable December 4, 2026. Executive Chairman Douglas G. Bergeron acknowledged years of declining earnings and past excessive special dividend distributions, emphasizing the need for disciplined capital allocation balancing shareholder returns with necessary business investments to restore growth and profitability.

AVXL.title: AVXL DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Anavex Life Sciences Corp. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm – AVXL
AVXL.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds investors of Anavex Life Sciences Corp. (NASDAQ: AVXL) who purchased securities between November 26, 2025 and August 28, 2026 of the November 30, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in an ongoing securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Anavex made false and misleading statements regarding inadequate internal controls, understated regulatory challenges related to former CEO Christopher Missling's misconduct, and misrepresented the company's business and prospects.

MPT.title: Lowey Dannenberg, P.C. is Investigating Medical Properties Trust, Inc. (NYSE: MPT) for Potential Violations of the Federal Securities Laws
MPT.summary: Law firm Lowey Dannenberg is investigating Medical Properties Trust (MPT) for potential federal securities violations related to alleged false statements about tenant HSA's financial condition and rent obligations. HSA failed to pay September rent and was unable to meet a scheduled 100% rent step-up, causing MPT stock to fall 11.3% to $2.44 per share on October 29, 2026.

KGC.title: KGC Stock Drop Alert: BFA Law Announces a Securities Fraud Class Action Against Kinross Gold Corporation has been Filed Following Mining Issues Disclosure
KGC.summary: Kinross Gold Corporation faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit after its stock dropped 11.5% on September 24, 2026. The company allegedly misrepresented its production capabilities and failed to disclose it lacked resources to achieve its 2.0 million ounce gold production guidance. Kinross subsequently cut its 2026-2027 production guidance to 1.84-1.86 million ounces, citing ore recovery challenges at its Round Mountain mine in Nevada. Investors have until January 5, 2027, to request lead plaintiff status.

KGC.title: KGC INVESTOR ALERT: Hagens Berman Urges Kinross Gold Corporation (NYSE: KGC) Investors with Substantial Losses to Contact Firm Ahead of January 5, 2027 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
KGC.summary: Hagens Berman has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Kinross Gold Corporation (KGC) in federal court, alleging violations of federal securities laws. Investors who purchased KGC shares between February 18, 2026 and September 23, 2026 and suffered substantial losses are urged to contact the firm before the January 5, 2027 lead plaintiff deadline.

BETR.title: BETTER HOME & FINANCE DEADLINE APPROACHING: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Better Home & Finance Holding Company Investors to Contact the Firm Before November 20th
BETR.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Better Home & Finance Holding Company (NASDAQ: BETR) in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit alleges that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its conversion funnel slowdown and its ability to meet its $1 billion monthly funded volume target. Investors who purchased Better Home securities between March 13, 2026 and August 6, 2026 have until November 20, 2026 to apply to be appointed as lead plaintiff.

BETRW.title: BETTER HOME & FINANCE DEADLINE APPROACHING: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Better Home & Finance Holding Company Investors to Contact the Firm Before November 20th
BETRW.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Better Home & Finance Holding Company (NASDAQ: BETR) in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit alleges that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its conversion funnel slowdown and its ability to meet its $1 billion monthly funded volume target. Investors who purchased Better Home securities between March 13, 2026 and August 6, 2026 have until November 20, 2026 to apply to be appointed as lead plaintiff.

COO.title: The Cooper Companies, Inc. Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in The Cooper Companies, Inc., You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
COO.summary: Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against The Cooper Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ: COO) for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information. The investigation was prompted by Cooper Companies' September 10, 2026 earnings report that disappointed Wall Street with weak guidance and a decision not to sell Cooper Surgical, causing the stock to fall 14.6% that day. Investors who purchased Cooper Companies securities may be eligible for compensation through a class action lawsuit.

CCB.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Urges Coastal Financial Corporation Investors to Contact the Firm Before December 1st Seeking Lead Plaintiff Role
CCB.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Coastal Financial Corporation for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements about its CCBX business growth and credit quality. The complaint alleges that Coastal failed to disclose that approximately $500 million in CCBX partner loans (23% of CCBX loans) had materially deteriorated, exposing the company to significant losses. Investors who purchased Coastal stock between October 28, 2024 and July 29, 2026 have until December 1, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

DVA.title: Lowey Dannenberg, P.C. is Investigating DaVita Inc. (NYSE: DVA) for Potential Violations of the Federal Securities Laws
DVA.summary: Law firm Lowey Dannenberg is investigating DaVita Inc. for potential securities law violations following the HHS announcement of a coordinated strategy to revitalize American kidney care by introducing competition measures and penalizing market dominance in the dialysis industry. DaVita's stock fell 6.23% ($11.65 per share) on October 20, 2026, following the announcement, as investors question whether the company adequately disclosed regulatory and competitive risks.

NNOX.title: Nanox Announces That Board Has Approved Cost Reduction and Operational Efficiency Measures
NNOX.summary: Nanox (NASDAQ: NNOX) announced a Board-approved cost reduction plan targeting 25-30% reduction in annualized operating expenses by end of Q1 2027, including workforce reductions and operational adjustments. The company is focusing on four strategic priorities: accelerating Nanox.ARC commercialization, strengthening commercial partnerships, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing financial flexibility. However, the company continues to face substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and will require additional financing.

PAC.title: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico Reports a Passenger Traffic Decrease in October 2026 of 7.0% Compared to 2025
PAC.summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) reported a 7.0% decrease in total passenger traffic across its 12 Mexican airports in October 2026 compared to October 2025. Major airports like Puerto Vallarta (-19.8%), Tijuana (-14.4%), and Los Cabos (-4.6%) experienced significant declines, though Guadalajara saw only a 1.3% decrease. Year-to-date traffic through October 2026 declined 4.5% compared to the same period in 2025. Load factors remained relatively stable at 81.0% in October 2026 versus 80.7% in October 2025.

BBW.title: Build-A-Bear Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Build-A-Bear Workshop, Inc., You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
BBW.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Build-A-Bear Workshop, Inc. (NYSE: BBW) for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information to investors. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses on a contingency fee basis.

AMFPY.title: Amplifon Data Breach Exposes Personal Information: Murphy Law Firm Investigates Legal Claims
